title: Trevor Lawrence on odd kneeldown: I was just trying to help Bhayshul Tuten fantasy owners

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Trevor Lawrence on odd kneeldown: I was just trying to help Bhayshul Tuten fantasy owners
sources.description: The Jaguars won in a laugher against the Patriots on Sunday and that made it much easier to laugh about an odd choice that Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence made in the fourth quarter of the game.
